en.headline: Customs seizes 5kg suspected cannabis at airport, arrests two
en.dek: Two mainland men arriving from Manila were arrested after officers found the drugs in a checked suitcase; they face trafficking charges in court tomorrow.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers at the airport detected about 5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds concealed in a check-in suitcase belonging to a 59-year-old mainland man who arrived from Manila on Saturday.

After investigation, a 58-year-old mainland man who arrived on the same flight was also arrested in connection with the case. Both have been jointly charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug and will appear at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday.

Customs said the estimated market value was about HK$1 million. The department said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement and reminded the public not to carry unknown items or accept payment to transport controlled goods.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢約5公斤懷疑大麻花 兩名內地男被捕
zh.dek: 兩名由馬尼拉抵港的內地男子被控販運危險藥物，案件明於西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，昨日在機場偵破一宗入境旅客販毒案件，在一名59歲內地男子的托運行李中檢獲約5公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約100萬元。
該男子由菲律賓馬尼拉抵港。調查後，海關再拘捕另一名同日由馬尼拉抵港的58歲內地男子。兩人已被共同控以一項販運危險藥物罪，案件將於明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關指會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，並提醒市民切勿貪圖金錢而參與販毒，亦不要為他人攜帶不明物品。
